fields.definition: Assessed physical illness or age-related susceptibility relevant to treatment tolerability.
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies a specific relevant physical condition or age-related vulnerability after assessment; Absent means relevant vulnerability was assessed and none identified. No age cutoff, automatic diagnosis or implication that physical illness is absent.
